verdict.rationale: Bevy's Scene system lets you save/load ECS worlds to files (bevy-docs-8), and the engine itself is fully open-source (MIT/Apache) with no lock-in (bevy-docs-18, bevy-docs-25, bevy-docs-35), meaning a user's project/data is never trapped in a proprietary format. However there is no explicit documentation of a standardized open export format, no migration/export tooling, and no evidence of interoperability with other engines. missing for 10: explicit open-format export/import tooling, documentation of scene file format standards, evidence of users successfully migrating data out.
